name: iw5x86
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (IW5, the original 32-bit build)
note: The original 32-bit MW3 (zones IWffu100 / IWff0100 v1: the same 21-byte header as the 2026 rebuild, 32-bit content). Exe: the Steam iw5mp.exe (2018-05-02 build, x86, not encrypted), flattened (file offset == RVA); its loaders read the single-player zones too (one clip map type; aipaths has a loader). iw5sp.exe is not used: Steam CEG left its asset name table's strings zeroed.
rva_note: read off iw5mp.exe, MW2's stream code with a ninth block: DB_LoadXFileData 0x4b8a40 (dst, size, 0 on the stack) is called by Load_Stream 0x4cddd0 (flag, dst, size: block 2, runtime, memsets; every other block reads; then DB_IncStreamPos 0x4cdd50) and by Load_XString 0x4cde70 (char**: one byte at a time); DB_PushStreamPos 0x4cdcc0 (block) and DB_PopStreamPos 0x4cdd00 (a pop into block 0 rewinds it) both through DB_SetStreamIndex 0x4cdc40 (edi; blocks 6 and 7 copied to their GPU buffers); DB_AllocStreamPos 0x4cdd30 (alignment - 1); DB_InitStreams 0x4cdb90 (the XBlock table, 8 bytes per block); DB_InsertPointer 0x4cdd60 pushes 3, aligns 4, takes 4 bytes, pops; DB_ConvertOffsetToPointer 0x4cde50 and DB_ConvertOffsetToAlias 0x4cde20 (dereferenced): block = (v - 1) >> 28, offset = (v - 1) & 0xfffffff

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAsset 0x4c9a10 (flag): Load_Stream(flag, varXAsset, 8), varXAssetHeader (0x13e2304) = varXAsset + 4, then Load_XAssetHeader 0x4c96b0 compares the type and tail-jumps to the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set

stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording (132 zones): blocks 3 (virtual, 4 391 396 reads), 6 (vertex, 119 798), 7 (index, 96 809) and 8 (script, 5 944) only grow; block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (521 829 of 522 526 reads below its previous end); 1, 4 and 5 hold nothing

zone_load.note: DB_LoadXFile's tail (0x4b85a1), inline: DB_InitStreams; the 16-byte XAssetList read raw into its static 0x1361c50 (varXAssetList 0x13e2338); push(3), varScriptStringList (0x13e28ec) = the list, Load_ScriptStringList(0) 0x4b8d20, pop; push(3); when `assets != 0` the array aligned 4 (0x4bf6e0) and Load_XAssetArray 0x4b8400 (eax = count): Load_Stream(1, list, count x 8), each entry through Load_XAsset(0) with varXAsset 0x13e20d4 = &entry; pop

release.note: 2026-11-13: the emulator consumes 132/132 zones to their last byte and the tables read them identically (emuwalk); all 132 recorded; measure 117/117 under its 256 MB cap, the 15 above compared by blocks native (C++ layout == recording, 132/132 zones, 4 613 947 reads); 770 350/770 350 occurrences exact
